annotations.title: Report a found offer, price or miss

description: Files a miss, price or found-offer report for Community mode (POST /api/reports/offer body, or reports: up to 10). Stores the store domain, code or deal, page URL, price, outcome and reason given; no cart or personal data.

amount_off.description: Amount off in the store's currency, above 0.

community.description: true in Community mode; a report with a url then requires a price.

connector.description: Name of that connector. Only with price_source connector.

consent.description: true: the shopper turned Community mode on. Required in each report, or once beside reports.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD. Default USD. Only with a price.

event_uuid.description: Optional UUID of this report; the server makes one when absent.

evidence_url.description: Public page that shows the offer.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 date, or a time with zone.

observed_at.description: When it was seen, ISO 8601 such as 2026-11-24T22:00:00Z (UTC when no zone). Default: now. With a price: within the last 48 hours.

outcome.description: worked: tried and it applied. failed: it did not, or it was only seen (reason other). Optional. Default: failed for miss and price, worked for the others. A miss is only failed.

percent_off.description: Percent off, above 0 and at most 100.

price.description: The product page's price, such as 19.99 ("$19.99" is accepted): above 0, at most 2 decimals, at most 100000. No tax or shipping.

price_source.description: Where the price was seen. page (default): the store's product page. connector: returned by a retailer connector or first-party shopping integration; also url, price and connector. Stored as a price only seen.

reason.description: Why a report is a miss or failed.

reports.description: A batch: 1 to 10 reports, each with the same fields as a single report. Beside it only consent and store are accepted, as the value for reports without their own. Each report gets its own result; a bad one does not fail the others.

amount_off.description: Amount off in the store's currency, above 0.

community.description: true in Community mode; a report with a url then requires a price.

connector.description: Name of that connector. Only with price_source connector.

consent.description: true: the shopper turned Community mode on. Required in each report, or once beside reports.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD. Default USD. Only with a price.

event_uuid.description: Optional UUID of this report; the server makes one when absent.

evidence_url.description: Public page that shows the offer.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 date, or a time with zone.

observed_at.description: When it was seen, ISO 8601 such as 2026-11-24T22:00:00Z (UTC when no zone). Default: now. With a price: within the last 48 hours.

outcome.description: worked: tried and it applied. failed: it did not, or it was only seen (reason other). Optional. Default: failed for miss and price, worked for the others. A miss is only failed.

percent_off.description: Percent off, above 0 and at most 100.

price.description: The product page's price, such as 19.99 ("$19.99" is accepted): above 0, at most 2 decimals, at most 100000. No tax or shipping.

price_source.description: Where the price was seen. page (default): the store's product page. connector: returned by a retailer connector or first-party shopping integration; also url, price and connector. Stored as a price only seen.

reason.description: Why a report is a miss or failed.

store.description: Store domain such as example.com (not a store name). Required in each report, or once beside reports.

title.description: Product name as the page has it. Only with a price.

type.description: Kind of report. Every type requires type, store and consent true. price (a price seen on a product page): also url and price; title and currency recommended. deal, sale, discount: a code, a url or the savings; with a price also the product page url (or a title when the page is unknown). coupon: also code. miss (nothing found, or a failed check): reason recommended.

url.description: The store's own http(s) product or offer page, on the store's domain. Required with a price. Not a /go link.

store.description: Store domain such as example.com (not a store name). Required in each report, or once beside reports.

title.description: Product name as the page has it. Only with a price.

url.description: The store's own http(s) product or offer page, on the store's domain. Required with a price. Not a /go link.
